speaker: john_heminges
text: The stage is cold, and it can stay cold. We open at Easter. We do not open this afternoon to keep our hands warm. Nobody has a tool out. I would like that to remain true until we are home.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Cold is the obedience. I said so in a porch, and I will say it on a stage that is not a stage today. No play. No bill of ours. If we mend anything, we mend it on a morning that was promised to a carpenter, and this is not that morning.

speaker: hired_men
text: I came up from the water with their paper. Seleo and Olympo. The Lord Admiral his servants. That is what the bill says. It does not say a man's name, and I am not going to invent one to sound informed.

speaker: will_kemp
text: We stop like Christians and they take three pound for it. That's pennies left lying on a table. I hope the pennies stick in their throats with the salt. I say it here because the porch would have fined me for the pleasure.

speaker: hired_men
text: That is your sum, Master Kemp. It is not mine. I saw the flag. I did not see his book. The flag was up over the Bankside as bold as brass. A flag is a fact. A book on the other bank is a rumour with handwriting, and I will not wear it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The Mayor counts which house played in Lent and which did not. Let him count. We are the house that did not. I would rather be counted idle than counted clever. Clever is how a company explains a Wednesday to a clerk and then meets the clerk again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Henslowe will be shut within a fortnight, and we shall all be equally idle. I am not crossing the river to hurry him. My own book still says 1594 at the head of the leaf. The year turns when the year turns. I am not ruling new columns to feel busy in a cold tiring-house.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A fortnight is a comfort you are giving yourself. I want the three pounds to be a scandal today, not a prophecy. You may be right. Right is a poor dinner. Raye, was the yard full, or was the flag doing the boasting for an empty house?

speaker: hired_men
text: The flag was doing what a flag does. I stood where I could see it, and I could see a press of them under it. I did not take their pennies in my hand. If you want the press described, it was a press. If you want it counted, find a man who was paid to count.

speaker: john_heminges
text: A season may have a name without every tradesman stopping at once. Lent is a name. Their afternoon is a trade. I can dislike the trade and still refuse to invent a fine for it. The Mayor's count is enough of a fine if we mean to be the house that stopped.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are that house. I am not painting a moral on his flag. Kemp, you have said three pounds. I heard you. I am not going to repeat it as if I had stood at his table. Raye stood at the flag. That is the witness we have, and a witness is not a receipt.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Keep your receipt. I have my bitterness, and it is warmer than this stage. Three pounds. Christians. A table of pennies. I shall say it all the way down Holywell Lane, and you may walk ahead of me so you are not seen agreeing.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Walk behind, and say it to the lane if you must. Do not say it to a constable, and do not say we were over the water. We were here. The here is cold. The cold is the point I am willing to explain, and it is the only point.

speaker: hired_men
text: I am not your constable, and I am not your gatherer. The bill can go on the bench. I am done carrying it. If the title is wanted again, it is Seleo and Olympo, and it is theirs. I did not see our name on any post on the way up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. Leave our name off. Easter is soon enough to have a name on a post. John, I am not asking you for a share of a day that has no play in it. There is no figure for today. There is a shut door and a long afternoon, and the afternoon can be long without becoming a sum.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A long afternoon is a player's idea of hell when the other hell is making money. I shall endure it. I shall endure it loudly, and not in a kitchen that can fine me a dinner. You need not come and supervise the enduring.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I was not going to. Shut the door when we leave. The stage stays empty. If a boy has left a property on it, it waits until a working morning. I am not inventing work to console a clown. Consolation is expensive, and the day is already costing us the taking we are not taking.

speaker: hired_men
text: Then I am for the lane. The flag will still be up when I look back, and I will not look back for your sake, Master Kemp. I have seen it once. Once is the report.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once is enough. A fortnight. Equal idleness. No new column in the book. You can have the bitterness, Kemp. You cannot have my name on his bill, and you cannot have me on his bank. I am walking down with John. The cold can keep the house until Easter.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Walk, then. I shall be bitter at a little distance, which is the polite form. Three pounds. I will not round them. Rounding is how a grievance becomes a brag, and I am grieving, not bragging. There is a difference. Abel would understand it. Abel is not here, which is why I am explaining it to the posts.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The posts have it. Come away. Easter. Not today. If you are still explaining at the gate I shall assume the cold has got into the explanation, and I shall not stand in the wind for a metaphor.

speaker: hired_men
text: I have said the title twice. I will not say a sum to make a third. The flag was up. That is the end of my errand.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Three pounds, and I am done with the posts. They are a cold congregation. Keep your fortnight, Will. I shall keep the grievance until it is useful or ridiculous, and Easter may choose which.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep it. Do not spend it on a constable, and do not spend it on me. The stage stays empty. Empty is not a rehearsal, and it is not a crossing.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Empty, and shut. Easter. If anyone asks what we did, we looked and we left and we did not play. I will not dress it richer than that.
